$comment: Completeness classification thresholds for WPuQ Phase 1. Edit these values; re-run scripts/build_inventory.py.

COMPLETE.description: Almost full calendar coverage; only tiny residual gaps.

USABLE_WITH_SMALL_GAPS.description: High coverage with limited gaps; suitable for first benchmarks if gaps are short.

INCOMPLETE.description: Substantial missing data; annual totals are biased low if summed only over finite samples.

EXCLUDE.description: Too sparse for annual statistics or profile validation.

notes: Availability = finite P_TOT samples / expected 15-min intervals for the calendar year in the file.
Expected intervals: 35040 (non-leap) or 35136 (leap). Feb 29 is retained in 2020 files.
NaN gaps are never filled. Annual kWh uses only finite samples and incomplete years are flagged.

Scientific Data paper used >90% availability as a descriptive quality cue and excluded houses missing ≥1 full month from 2019 annual averages. Our Phase 1 classes are stricter/explicit for benchmark selection.
